value.rationale: The coexistence of two attractor types at one rational step lies strictly above a fundamental monotone-descent threshold while both expected twist sinks remain stable. Two new open positive-measure attracting basins preclude almost-global twisted-state attraction in a natural finite-step regime, an important structural boundary for frustrated phase networks rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
